subject: an indigo folded-roof pavilion on a pale golden plane
art_direction: 靛蓝折顶小亭置于浅金平面上，长阴影与青灰远光构成克制漂亮的最终几何景观。
visible_description: 靛蓝折顶小亭置于浅金平面上，长阴影与青灰远光构成克制漂亮的最终几何景观。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create an indigo folded-roof pavilion on a pale golden plane. The roof consists of two overlapping broad folds above a plain open room. A long cool shadow stretches toward the lower edge, giving depth to the simple setting. Keep the pavilion small enough that the upper fifth remains broad quiet sky. Use a few subtle brush variations in the planes, with no people, signs, or extra objects. Use hard-edge painterly architecture. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
